ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course starts June 15 and ends August 5. Classes will be on Tuesday and Thursday evenings from 6:00 to 8:50 PM in the University Hall Building (UBH), room 2024 on the University of Illinois at Springfield campus. Students without current or recent supervisory experience are strongly encouraged to enroll in this course section. The email address for the instructor is tomward@illinois.edu.
